layout_concept: Quiet four-page monograph. Every inner page opens with a Georgia section title above one full-width hairline; one dominant graphic per page (hero photo, portrait+square pair, plan, panorama) bottom-aligned to the margin at 198 mm. Cover: hero on top, title beneath hairline, narrow meta column right. Pages alternate image-top / image-bottom.
principles: one accent colour (deep teal) used only for small labels
serif for titles and the single pull-quote, sans for facts
the plan is the largest object of the book and keeps its original aspect
white space instead of filler; text only from project.md
generic_defaults_checked: identical cards avoided: four different compositions
